Why we exist

A career decision should never depend on half the story.

National Global Academy was created around a straightforward idea: students deserve an exciting vision of their future, and parents deserve the practical facts needed to evaluate it.

Careers at sea are often presented through glamorous photographs and large salary claims. We focus instead on route selection, foundational skills, professional readiness and careful verification. That means explaining who provides training, what external certification may be required, which costs sit outside tuition and why no ethical institution can guarantee a job.

Our mission

Make maritime career planning clearer, safer and more honest.

To help each student identify a suitable pathway, build relevant workplace readiness and approach the next stage with verified information—while keeping parents part of the decision.

Clarity before enrolment Honesty before promotion Preparation before promises
How we work

Route-specific guidance

Family involvement

Why parents can trust the conversation

We make room for difficult questions.

What if my child is homesick? Is the employer genuine? What happens if medical eligibility changes? Which payments are refundable? Who do we call in an emergency? A trustworthy counselling process should not rush past these questions. [CONFIRM: Add verified parent-support practices, emergency contact process and campus safety policies.]

Trust is not a statistic on a banner. It is a clear answer, a written document and the freedom to decide without pressure.
